notes: §2002:14.8.45.3 GR11: the exception condition that selects the USE statement is the first that occurs in the order of evaluation. In COMPUTE X = 10 ** N / Z, N = 1000, 10 ** N exceeds 10^1000 - 10^968 (§2002:8.8.1.3.1.1) and raises EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW (CobolDec.ToSidi) before the division by zero is reached: the EC-SIZE declarative displays EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW (the 34-digit engine had no overflow there and reached EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE).
